title: What can wash away
lyrics_original: What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
For my pardon, this I see,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my cleansing this my plea,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.     ||Oh Precious||
Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.     ||Oh Precious||
This is all my hope and peace,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
This is all my righteousness,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.    ||Oh Precious||

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే ఆయన వెలుగులోనున్న ప్రకారము మనమును వెలుగులో నడిచినయెడల. మనము అన్యోన్యసహవాసము గలవారమై యుందుము; అప్పుడు ఆయన కుమారుడైన యేసు రక్తము ప్రతి ఎ
bible_verses.english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా ఈ మాట సెలవిచ్చుచున్నాడు రండి మన వివాదము తీర్చుకొందము మీ పాపములు రక్తమువలె ఎఱ్ఱనివైనను అవి హిమము  వలె తెల్లబడును కెంపువలె ఎఱ్ఱనివైనను అవి గొఱ్ఱబొచ్చువలె తెల్లని వగును.
bible_verses.english: “Come now, let us settle the matter,” says the Lord. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.”

bible_verses.telugu: మరియు ధర్మశాస్త్ర ప్రకారము సమస్త వస్తువులును రక్తముచేత శుద్ధిచేయబడుననియు, రక్తము చిందింపకుండ పాప క్షమాపణ కలుగదనియు సామాన్యముగా చెప్పవచ్చును.
bible_verses.english: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the priceless gift of Your forgiveness and grace. When I am tempted to carry the weight of my own shortcomings, remind me that Your sacrifice has already made me whole. Thank You for cleansing my heart and granting me true peace with the Father. Help me to walk today in the joy and freedom of Your unending love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the priceless gift of Your forgiveness and grace. When I am tempted to carry the weight of my own shortcomings, remind me that Your sacrifice has already made me whole. Thank You for cleansing my heart and granting me true peace with the Father. Help me to walk today in the joy and freedom of Your unending love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often leaves us feeling weighed down by mistakes and regret, searching for ways to fix ourselves. Yet this beloved hymn gently reminds us that true cleansing and wholeness cannot be earned—they are a grace freely given through Jesus. His sacrifice removes every stain and restores us completely before God. As you sing, let go of self-reliance and rest deeply in the quiet assurance that His mercy is more than enough for you.
